note: Binary Buster (MOVES.md; the other plays thrown, held 3.4 m in front and lifted 0.1 m a frame to 3 m by the fight): the Hero's throw (base) on the combined form's rig, a frame sooner: both hands take the other's shoulders (frames 0-4, the break window to 10), the knees bend to take the weight and the arms press it up overhead as the legs straighten (4-22), the body rears back at the waist coupling (26) and heaves it forward and away (release mark on 29: the slam the fight acts on), following through low before it settles back into the guard.
